title: How shofars became the spiritual soundtrack of Rosh Hashanah
content: Rosh Hashanah, the Jewish New Year, begins at sunset Friday. For many Jews around the world, a highlight of the holiday will be hearing the shofar: an animal's horn blown like a trumpet.

title: Amid war and sanctions, many Iranians are losing their jobs and struggling to get by
content: Many Iranians lost their jobs because of the war and the U.S. blockade. Now some are even losing their backup jobs as sanctions tighten.

title: In photos: Remembering the Sept. 11 attacks, 25 years later
content: Around the U.S., ceremonies commemorate the 25th anniversary of the Sept. 11th terror attacks in New York and at the Pentagon.

title: As diseases loom, CDC's response to measles deaths stirs fears about agency's reliability
content: The worst U.S. measles outbreak in decades is growing and flu season is imminent. Experts are fretting about federal health data reliability after the CDC questioned two Pennsylvania measles deaths.

title: Is Patagonia the new data center hub? + Harley-Davidson's role in the trade war
content: Why Patagonia might become a new data center hub

title: The voices of Sept. 11: 'My first thought was ... I can't believe that I survived'
content: We listen back to interviews recorded in the aftermath of Sept. 11, with a particular focus on stories of survival and loss at the World Trade Center, and some reflections in poetry and music.

title: Remembering 9/11. And, Vance, Trump urge voters to back Republicans in the midterms
content: NPR reflects on the events of 9/11 and the toll it left on the U.S. 25 years later. And, President Trump and Vice President Vance's convention speeches urge voters to back the GOP in the midterms.

title: US diesel prices soar past $6 a gallon, deepening strain for hauling everyday goods
content: Diesel prices in the U.S. has hit yet another record, soaring past $6 a gallon on average as Washington's war with Iran disrupts the world's flow of fuel

title: Will you get $5,000 to do the news quiz? No. But will it be fun? Maybe
content: Plus: donkeys, maps, art, iPhones and more!

title: They cleaned up ground zero. Now many are hiding from ICE
content: After 9/11, thousands of rescue and cleanup crews went to work at ground zero. They were exposed to toxic debris and experienced psychological trauma. Today, many say they live in fear of deportation.
